_how: Blob numbers come from: scripts/gauge-dial.py blobs <p61-005.png> <dir> epu 106 113 62 95 140 (p61-005.png = pdfimages -j -f 61 -l 61 image 005 converted to PNG). Blob 12 is the needle over the 100 % tick; 1, 3, 7, 13-26, 32, 36, 38 are numerals and legends. Then: scripts/gauge-dial.py fit <p61-005.png> <dir> <this file>.
